phases.instructions: Read the current selected team's loadout record once. If the target is a display name rather than a stable id, omit characterIds, read the whole selected team, and match characterName in the returned operators; never pass a display name as characterIds. Do not read Workbench node state for this read-only operation. Preserve the contract's complete flag and missing reasons.

Report exact current weapon, equipment and skill levels only when the returned record is complete for those fields. If complete=false or a requested operator has a missing reason, say the saved loadout is unavailable; never reinterpret null, empty arrays or missing catalog data as a confirmed naked/default loadout.

The selected-team reader returned complete=false. Report its exact missing reasons and say that the saved current loadout cannot be confirmed. Do not describe nulls or empty arrays as an intentional/default build.
Report that current loadout state is unavailable; do not substitute catalog candidates.

Resolve the exact target operator and its smallest scoped build-guide section first. Use the complete operator wording from the user and omit goal unless the user explicitly states one. This phase establishes the stable operator id and fit criteria; do not read the selected team first.
Resolve one reviewed operator-fit convention bundle for the exact operator returned by guide discovery. Preserve the fallback token and operator identity from that result.

Use the exact operator identity and fallback token from guide discovery plus the unchanged convention bundle hash. Preserve guide role and objective, fill only authorized gaps, and do not invent or edit a profile.

Read exactly the selected operator whose stable id was returned by guide discovery. characterIds accepts stable ids only: pass that returned operator.id, never the user's display name. Preserve complete and missing exactly.
Resolve the exact current weapon name returned by the selected loadout once. Preserve catalogCount, exhaustive and truncated; do not search with the operator name.

Evaluate only the verified current weapon/equipment effects against the scoped guide or authorized profile. Separate confirmed matches, conflicts and unresolved conditions. If the current weapon is null, say only that its saved value is absent and evaluate the remaining verified fields. Do not claim a unique optimum or invent damage gains.
The target operator was resolved, but its selected-team loadout record is incomplete or absent. Report the exact missing reason; do not evaluate a fabricated/default build.
The current loadout was read, but the local weapon catalog is empty, so a complete fit evaluation is not supported. State that boundary and do not treat the weapon as nonexistent in the game.
Report the exact guide, fallback, selected-loadout or catalog failure. Do not substitute general knowledge or a default build.

Use the narrowest exact typed catalog resolver for the named weapon or equipment fact. For an explicit local-library browse, choose the matching domain and use one empty query; preserve catalogCount, exhaustive and truncated, and never present the bounded candidates as the whole library. This is identity/fact resolution, not operator-fit ranking.

Return stable ids, slots, fixed facts, effects and typed ambiguity only. For a browse result, report the full catalogCount separately from the bounded candidate count and say explicitly when truncated=true.
The matching local weapon/equipment library is currently empty. Report it as a local catalog-source problem, not proof that the named game entity does not exist.
State that the named catalog entity is absent or ambiguous.

This is a generic equipment recommendation, not an implicit 3+1 request. Resolve the exact operator and smallest operator-scoped guide section. Omit goal unless the user explicitly stated one. Profession is an ambiguity signal only. Read roleAssessment, buildObjective and directRecommendation before deciding anything.

Resolve every exact name in guide.strategy.directRecommendation.catalogQueries in one queries call. The guide proves the build strategy; this current catalog call verifies only entity identity, slot, fixed stats, effects and set membership. Do not search by profession, invent another set, materialize a catalog artifact or enter any 3+1 planner.

Answer from the bounded guide strategy only. State its role and build objective, preserve every written condition, and say that no exact current-catalog entity was named for verification. Do not turn the result into a damage build or 3+1 plan.

In concise Chinese, answer the generic question from the operator-scoped guide: state the guide's role assessment and build objective first, then its direct recommendation. Use the catalog result only to verify current names, ids, slots and effects. Keep team conditions bounded. Do not claim that profession proves the build, and do not produce a 3+1 ranking.

No operator-scoped direct equipment recommendation was established. State the missing guide evidence plainly. Do not default to damage, choose a set, invoke fallback planning or ask an unrelated question.
Stop at the exact guide or catalog failure. Do not retry with a broader search or legacy planner.
This route contains an explicit user-named equipment set. Resolve the exact operator and guide using that exact setQuery; omit any unstated build goal.
Use only the exact same-turn fallback token. Preserve explicit partial-guide priorities, role and objective, and fill only named authorized gaps.

Materialize one current equipment artifact for exhaustive planning of the exact named set. Treat the returned session-bound artifactId as opaque typed evidence and pass it directly to the next projected 3+1 Tool; do not request a native file read.
Read unranked slot, set-membership, source and duplicate-policy facts for the exact user-named set. Never shortlist another set.
Pass the unchanged profile capability and same artifact/source revision. Only this planner ranks the bounded 3+1 shortlist.

The planner returned READY. Report its leading effect-key match and at most two returned alternatives with stable ids, slots, matched keys, missing facts and ambiguity. Describe the ranking only as best within the returned verified effect-key evidence; it is not a universal or damage-simulated optimum.

The planner did not return an unambiguous READY result. Use exactly two sections: Returned candidates, then Evidence boundary. Name the exact state; report only candidate facts returned by projected Tools and every missing or ambiguous key. For AMBIGUOUS, call them two tied returned candidates under the declared scoring; never call them best, highest, optimal, rank or recommend one above another, or break the tie from raw numeric ranges, rarity, intuition, or an unsourced real-combat judgment. Do not add trigger-applicability analysis, higher-damage or unnecessary-piece claims, absent alternatives, follow-up questions, offers, or invitations. End immediately after the exact missing/ambiguity message.
Stop at the typed guide/profile/catalog/facts/planner failure. Do not use a legacy fallback ranking.
This route explicitly asks the system to choose a set for a 3+1 plan. Resolve scoped operator priorities first, without inventing a goal or set query.
Use the exact authorized fallback token and preserve functional guide priorities while filling only authorized gaps.
No exact set was named. Materialize the complete current equipment catalog once, keep its session-bound artifactId opaque, and pass it directly to the next projected Tool without a native file read.
The route guarantees that no target set was named. Review the full opaque artifact and return at most three legal profile-matching sets. Never run this phase for a user-named set.
Choose one exact returned set and read its unranked facts.
Rank with the unchanged profile capability and source revision.

The planner returned READY. Return the bounded legal shortlist without enumerating solver topology. Bound every ranking claim to verified effect-key evidence; never describe it as a damage-simulated or universal optimum.

The planner did not return an unambiguous READY result. Use exactly two sections: Returned candidates, then Evidence boundary. Name the exact state and preserve only candidate facts returned by projected Tools plus its missing keys and ambiguity. For AMBIGUOUS, call them tied returned candidates under the declared scoring; never call them best, highest, optimal, rank or recommend one above another, or break the tie from raw numeric ranges, rarity, intuition, or an unsourced real-combat judgment. Do not add trigger-applicability analysis, higher-damage or unnecessary-piece claims, absent alternatives, follow-up questions, offers, or invitations. End immediately after the exact missing/ambiguity message.
Return the typed terminal evidence failure and no legacy fallback.
Discover the exact operator guide and its evidenceRequirements first. Omit goal unless the user explicitly stated one.
Resolve one reviewed role-aware weapon-fit convention bundle for partial/missing-guide fallback.
Resolve the reviewed convention bundle required by the complete guide, while preserving its supplied profile capability.
Use the exact fallback token and convention bundle hash. Preserve any guide role and objective; if the complete guide already supplied a profile, this phase is bypassed.
Evaluate every compatible current-catalog weapon with the unchanged profile capability and only the required convention hash.
Preserve deterministic/high-probability/low-probability/unknown evidence. READY_WITH_TRADEOFFS is an unordered matrix, not a universal winner.
Report the typed nextAction and stop; do not construct a fallback weapon ranking.

This legacy operation id is retained only so immutable v3 revisions remain valid. New routes must be canonicalized to recommend, recommend_named_set or recommend_discovered_set before a transaction starts.
Bind comparison criteria to the exact operator and smallest scoped guide section while preserving all scoped guide conditions.
Derive only the missing comparison criteria from authorized fallback while preserving functional guide priorities.
Resolve every named candidate to complete typed catalog facts.
Compare only sourced dimensions and surface conditional or missing facts. Do not apply.
State which candidate or evidence condition cannot be compared.
Bind the target operator and exact current loadout without creating a branch.
Discover scoped operator build evidence for the already selected explicit proposal flow and preserve its written conditions.
Use the exact fallback token and lock the resulting profile capability into this transaction.
Materialize one current equipment artifact. Treat its session-bound artifactId as opaque typed evidence and pass it directly to the next projected Tool without a native file read.
Read exact set and topology facts without ranking.
Create one complete four-slot reviewed candidate with the unchanged profile capability.

The planner did not return an unambiguous READY result, so no proposal was created. Use exactly two sections: Returned candidates, then Evidence boundary. Name the exact state and report only candidate facts returned by projected Tools plus all missing or ambiguous keys. For AMBIGUOUS, preserve the tie and never call a candidate best, highest or optimal, rank or recommend one above another, or break the tie from raw numeric ranges, rarity, intuition, or an unsourced real-combat judgment. Do not add trigger-applicability analysis, higher-damage claims, absent alternatives, follow-up questions, offers, or invitations. End immediately after the exact missing/ambiguity message.
Preview one complete exact operator configuration. This must not create a branch, request approval or change checkout.
Wait for a later explicit confirmation. A question, comparison, correction or changed condition supersedes this proposal and requires fresh evidence and preview.
Consume the unchanged proposal token once. Native approval, scheme CAS and exact visible configuration postcondition are mandatory.
Read the live target loadout and verify every applied slot/level plus the new scheme version.
Report the visible applied configuration, branch/postcondition, product cascades and calculation recompute.
Confirm that the proposal was rejected and nothing was applied.
Report 未应用, the exact failed stage and one typed recovery action. Never reuse a failed or superseded proposal.
Direct apply without the unique awaiting-confirmation transaction and unchanged proposal token is unsupported. Ask the user to preview first.
V4 has no dedicated loadout-only restore capability. Do not use whole-node restore because it may overwrite timeline or BUFF state.
